reference.application: Retain intro / chorus / verse / chorus / verse / chorus / chorus / chorus. Sunbird guitar takes the vocal role; offbeat guitar, bass and one-drop drums anchor the verses; electric-piano voicings and shaker define the choruses.

mastering_plan.approval: Reference-led review adaptation; no new melody or full mix is owner-accepted.
mastering_plan.normalization: Native controlled gain plus light peak protection; final codec files measured independently.

melody_validation: Original section order, tune pitches and logical rhythm retained across documented handoffs. Pan roll retriggers subdivide selected sustained notes; Castle flute takes selected phrases one octave higher.
